newsitem.title: USA: Idan Software to take $1.24 mln writeoff.
newsitem.headline: Idan Software to take $1.24 mln writeoff.

text.p: Israel's Idan Software Industries-I.S.I. Ltd. said on Wednesday that for the quarter ended Sept 30 it will take a charge against earnings of NIS 4 million (US$1.25 million).
The company said the amount represented the writeoff of the remaining value of Idan's investment in its majority-owned subsidiary, ASP Computer Products Inc.

After giving effect to the writeoff, Idan's shareholders' equity as of June 30, 1996 was NIS 32.29 million (US$10 million) on a proforma basis as compared to NIS 36.3 million (US$11.3 million) without giving effect to the write-off. ASP designs, manufactures and sells computer connectivity products.

"Management's decision to write-off the remaining value of ASP is based on a number of factors, including a significant reduction in ASP revenues, continued significant operating and net losses and erosion of gross profit margins and continued intense competition in ASP's market," Idan said.
Idan is seeking to divest its equity interest in ASP, although it plans to retain about $580,000 of unsecured subordinated notes issued by ASP to Idan.
